biography: Armin Bernhard, a name whispered with a mix of admiration and exasperation in the German motorsport scene, hails from a small village nestled in the shadow of the Nürburgring. His father, a former amateur rally driver, instilled a love for speed and competition in him from a young age, karting from the age of eight. Armin quickly outgrew the local circuits, his aggressive, flamboyant style often clashing with the more conservative approach of his peers. A defining moment came at the German National Karting Championship in 2016, where, despite starting last after a qualifying mishap, he clawed his way to victory with a daring last-lap overtake, showcasing his raw talent and relentless spirit. Now at 26, Armin is a rising star within Team Midas Racing, turning heads and ruffling feathers as he aims to climb the ladder towards the pinnacle of motorsport. The pressure is on, and Armin knows he needs to refine his talent to truly make his mark. His recent move to single-seaters is proving a challenge, his flashy style needing a more nuanced approach to succeed at this level.
drivingStyle: Armin's driving style can be described as 'controlled chaos.' He attacks corners with unmatched aggression, often pushing the limits of grip to gain every possible advantage. While his raw speed is undeniable, his tire management has been a persistent weakness, leading to late-race drop-offs. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest, but this intense focus can sometimes lead to reckless maneuvers and costly mistakes.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry from their karting days. Klaus, a more calculated and consistent driver, sees Armin as reckless and undisciplined. Their contrasting styles often lead to heated battles on track.
A clash of egos within Team Midas Racing. Isabelle, a seasoned veteran, resents Armin's perceived arrogance and quick rise within the team. The tension between them is palpable.

Kenji represents the new wave of meticulously trained sim racers. Armin dismisses him as a 'video game driver' lacking the grit of real-world experience, a sentiment Kenji is keen to disprove on the track.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky driving gloves, which are heavily worn and patched.
Listens to classical music before every race to calm his nerves, a stark contrast to his on-track persona.
Refuses to discuss race strategy with anyone before the final briefing, believing it jinxes his chances.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser. And I don't do losing.
careerHighlight: Winning the German National Karting Championship in 2016 after starting last, showcasing his exceptional overtaking skills and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Hockenheimring Formula Regional race in 2023, costing him a crucial victory and damaging his reputation.
